disposition_reason: Table 1 prints ranges of 14 elements, including cadmium, lead, nickel and chromium, in commercial cricket powders and four farmed insect species bought in the Czech Republic.

study.design: retail survey of cricket powders and four farmed insect species
study.market: retail supermarkets and pet shops in the South Moravian region, Czech Republic
study.method: microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion; HR-CS GF-AAS (Cd, Co, Cr, Fe, Ni, P, Pb), F-AAS (Ca, Cu, Mn, Mg, Zn), F-AES (K, Na)
study.qa: four CRMs (SRM 1570a spinach, INCT-TL-1 tea, BCR-482 lichen, BCR-191 brown bread); recoveries 90-106%
